high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "bloombergbusiness." The post features a headline that reads: "Pot smokers, Amazon wants you." The content of the post discusses Amazon's advice to its delivery partners to prominently advertise that they do not screen applicants for marijuana use. According to Bloomberg, this can boost the number of job applicants by as much as 400%, according to one message, without explaining how the statistic was arrived at. Conversely, the company states that screening for marijuana cuts the prospective worker pool by up to 30%.
